docs.latin: Fold-matching words in three scripts, space-separated.

source:
## Semantics: U2 (rs#297) — case-insensitive literals fold over Unicode
## simple case folding, not just ASCII: the compile emits a fold regex
## and every engine must agree on the folded match set. Latin-1 accents,
## the Greek sigma family (all four sigmas fold together), and Cyrillic
## pin the agreement; the plain-ASCII lookalike is the reject pin.
grammar ConformanceUnicodeFold version "1.0.0" mode "v1" {
  ## Fold-matching words in three scripts, space-separated.
  latin = %i"café"
  greek = %i"σοφος"
  cyrillic = %i"дон"
  name = ( latin / greek / cyrillic ) as name
  names = name *( %x20 name )

  entry main: names

  test main {
    accept "café σοφος дон"
    accept "CAFÉ ΣΟΦΟΣ ДОН"
    accept "Café Σοφος Дон"
    accept "café ΣΟΦΟΣ дОн"
    reject "cafe"
    reject "CAFE"
    reject "café x"
  }
}
